title: Pet-brand expenses can be accepted as Groceries
original_report: A confirmed 770 UAH expense labeled 'булка Долли' appeared in the Products column instead of the Булка / Долли pet category.
discovery_scope: FinanceAgent explicit, model-proposed, and fallback category selection
Read-only inspection of the current hidden Google Sheets receipt ledger
expected: Explicit pet-brand and pet-purpose labels always log category Pets and project to Булка / Долли.
actual: A valid but incorrect Gemini category such as Groceries overrode the deterministic pet fallback.
environment: Windows, project virtual environment, Python 3.14, pytest 9
reproduction: A focused async test supplies three explicit pet labels while the mocked provider proposes Groceries, then inspects the category passed to the real transaction tool boundary.
failure_signal: All three cases passed category Groceries to FinanceTools.log_transaction instead of Pets.
root_cause: Pet terms existed only in the fallback classifier. Any allowed Gemini category was accepted before fallback, even when the transaction text explicitly named the pet brand or animal food.
fix_summary: Treat brand prefix 'булка дол' and explicit pet-purpose terms as deterministic Pets categories before invoking Gemini.
why_causal: The explicit category branch has priority over model categorization, so recognized pet transactions can no longer be overridden by an allowed but semantically wrong provider response.

reproduction_files.summary: Approved parametrized regression for pet brand aliases and dog food.

fix_files.summary: Adds deterministic pet terms to the explicit-category path.

residual_risks: The existing 770 UAH row remains categorized as Products until historical production data is deliberately corrected.

No migration, dependency, secret, or production data was changed.
